notes.title: The Planetologist 0.6.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Thank you for joining us during the development of The Planetologist. This is version 0.6.0, which we believe is very close to the Early Access release of the game.

From now on, we’ll be publishing updates more frequently and working more closely with tester feedback. The game still has bugs and mechanics we’re improving, but the goal is to start showing its progress so we can enhance the gameplay experience based on player input.

Thank you all for being part of this journey!

Best regards,
The Developers

- Added tutorial and tips.
- General balancing.
Fixed crash on start with fresh installs.

- Added some pickup FX.
- Added locked achievement sprites.
- Some rebalancing.
- Fixed issue when erasing data.
